proof:
Source: Simon 8.2.5–2.6 (δV(X) = −∫ ν·X d‖δV‖ with |ν| = 1 ‖δV‖-a.e.), the estimate used in step 3 of the parent proof to bound |δW(X_t)|. Notation: ‖δW‖ := variationMeasure W; hW the locally-bounded-first-variation hypothesis.

1. X is a test field of U: it is C¹; tsupport X ⊆ K with K compact, so tsupport X is a closed subset of a compact set, hence compact, i.e. HasCompactSupport X; and tsupport X ⊆ K ⊆ U. Let T : Varifold.TestVectorField U be the test field with underlying function X.

2. Since hW holds, variationMeasure W = W.firstVariationRieszMeasure hW =: λ (definition of variationMeasure, positive branch of the dependent if). By Varifold.isFirstVariationPolarRepresentation_riesz, with ν := W.firstVariationPolarField hW: ‖ν(x)‖ = 1 for λ-a.e. x, and for the test field T the function x ↦ ⟨ν(x), X(x)⟩ is λ-integrable with W.firstVariation X = −∫⟨ν(x), X(x)⟩ dλ(x).

3. Hence ofReal|W.firstVariation X| = ‖∫⟨ν, X⟩ dλ‖ₑ ≤ ∫⁻ ‖⟨ν(x), X(x)⟩‖ₑ dλ(x) (Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs, enorm_integral_le_lintegral_enorm).

4. For λ-a.e. x: if x ∈ K, then ‖⟨ν(x), X(x)⟩‖ ≤ ‖ν(x)‖·‖X(x)‖ = ‖X(x)‖ ≤ B (norm_inner_le_norm), so ‖⟨ν(x), X(x)⟩‖ₑ ≤ ofReal B = 1_K(x)·ofReal B; if x ∉ K, then x ∉ tsupport X, so X(x) = 0 and the integrand is 0 = 1_K(x)·ofReal B.

5. Therefore ∫⁻ ‖⟨ν, X⟩‖ₑ dλ ≤ ∫⁻ 1_K·ofReal B dλ = ofReal B·λ(K) (lintegral_mono_ae; lintegral_indicator_const, K being closed hence Borel). With step 3: ofReal|W.firstVariation X| ≤ ofReal B · variationMeasure W K. ∎

variationMeasure W is the Riesz measure; polar representation δW(X) = −∫⟨ν,X⟩ d‖δW‖ with |ν| = 1 a.e.
Pointwise a.e.: ‖⟨ν,X⟩‖ₑ ≤ 1_K·ofReal B (X = 0 off tsupport X ⊆ K)
